target: constraint_arithmetic._get_dcp_value — deterministic, conservative selection among multiple matching DCP controls + conflict data-gap flag
findings_summary: Pure in-memory logic on the already-fetched DCPControl list — NO new DB query, schema, join, or loop over production tables. Read-only audit of dcp_setback_controls is complete: 62 conflict groups across 28 LGAs (9 unconditioned/suspect e.g. burwood front 9/15, 53 legit-tiered) where _get_dcp_value currently takes the LAST matching row arbitrarily and ignores `condition`. Fix: for minimum-requirement controls return max(value_min) (largest setback = smallest buildable = fail-safe, never over-reports capacity); for prefer_max caps return min(value_max) (smallest allowance); single-row callers are unchanged; conflicts (>1 distinct value) surface as a gap. Tier-accurate matching by parsing condition text is a separate larger follow-up.
model_design: Replace the last-row-wins loop with _matching_controls() (exact dev_type rows, else dwelling_house fallback) + max/min reduction. Add _dcp_value_conflict() returning sorted distinct values when >1, used in compute to append a 'conflicting setback' gap. Covered by tests/test_setback_conflict_resolution.py.
